mentions.name: hackernewsalerts.com
mentions.description: An open-source service that tracks replies to a user's own Hacker News comments and posts and notifies them; currently in maintenance mode after gathering less interest than hoped.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a similar domain - https://hackernewsalerts.com - but it's for tracking replies to comments and posts you've made. It's on maintenance mode at the moment, couldn't gather as much interest as I'd hoped. Have open sourced it.
